# Copilot Instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository architecture, validation, permissions,
credential handling and automation constraints. [README.md](../README.md) describes the
implemented workflows and operational behavior.

The [estate analysis alignment plan](../docs/plans/estate-analysis-alignment.md) defines a
future migration across applicable `platform-workloads`-managed repositories, excluding
`xi-*` and uncatalogued repositories. Do not treat planned workflows or policy as already
implemented, and do not execute the migration merely because the plan exists.
